annotations.title: Add a knowledge source to a chatbot

description:
Add a knowledge source to a chatbot

Adds one knowledge source to a chatbot. `type` says how to read `content`: for `url` it is the address to draw from, read again every `syncInterval` (weekly by default), for `text` it is the literal text, for `file` it is the text of the file, named by `fileName` and described by `mimeType`, and for `crawl` it is the start page of a website that is read up to `maxDepth` links deep and `maxPages` pages and crawled again every `syncInterval`. A crawl runs in the background with status `pending`; follow it with `GET /chatbots/{chatbotId}/knowledge/crawl`. `content` is always required and must not be empty. The document is created in the voice engine and then attached to the chatbot, which from then on draws on it in conversations. The entry is stored under the account that owns the chatbot, also when a reseller key adds it. When the document cannot be created or attached, the request still succeeds and the entry is stored with status `failed`; delete it and add it again. Note that the 400 response for an invalid body carries only an error code and a `details` list, with no `message` key, unlike the other endpoints.

body.description: The knowledge source. `title`, `fileName` and `mimeType` are optional and stored as given; without a `title` the entry is named after the URL or the file name.

maxDepth.description: For `crawl`: how many links deep the crawl follows from the start page.

maxPages.description: For `crawl`: at most this many pages are read.

syncInterval.description: For `url` and `crawl`: how often the page or website is read again. Defaults to weekly, `off` reads it once.
